newsitem.title: USA: Collaborative Clinical, Avanti may team up.
newsitem.headline: Collaborative Clinical, Avanti may team up.

text.p: Collaborative Clinical Research Inc said Monday it has signed a preliminary letter of understanding with Avanti Health Systems Inc to explore the possible creation of a research alliance.

The company said it hoped that through an alliance, it would have access to Avanti's managed physicians and their patients to conduct clinical, health economics, outcomes and disease management research sponsored by pharmaceutical companies.
The alliance is to be explored throughout the rest of the year. The companies said they expect to launch the venture in January 1997.
Avanti, which is based in New York, is a physician practice management company with regional offices in New York, Illinois, Houston, Dalls, Washington, D.C., Virginia and Maryland.
